auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (12/7/3), with 3 wave-4 fought, 9 contests survived, 4 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices.
noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TENDER — YOU TEACH MORE THAN YOU TAKE. I AM... KEEPING UP. BARELY. DO NOT SLOW DOWN ON MY ACCOUNT."
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; the relay carried faithfully. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ Natalie Pawlowski walks out of the light alone, which is how they walked in — and the audience, which came to be entertained, leaves humming the village's name. The village endures, loved and unbeholden, and the lights stay warm behind them.

plan.why: Nobody is here to feast with.
